quote_or_summary: POST /storage/v1/object/bucket/path uploads a file. Authorization requires Bearer token with key in header.
notes: REST API specifications for standard uploads.

quote_or_summary: Public buckets do not require authorization tokens to read objects. Public URL format: /storage/v1/object/public/bucket/path.
GET /advancedsearch.php with params q, output=json, and fl[] returns search results in JSON structure.
Files inside an Archive.org item can be directly downloaded using the URL pattern: archive.org/download/{identifier}/{filename}.
All sound recordings published before January 1, 1923, have entered the public domain. Pre-1972 sound recordings transition into public domain on a rolling 100-year term (1923-1925 enter by 2026).
The protection term for sound recordings and video recordings is fifty years from the year of publication. After that, they enter the public domain in Vietnam.
Assets placed in public/ are copied to the build output. Heavy assets in Git increase repository size, cloning time, and slow down deployment.
notes: Astro best practices on large assets.

quote_or_summary: Only environment variables prefixed with PUBLIC_ are available in client-side code in Astro.
Decided to hoan SPEC_10 (sales of Indie artist music) to Phase 2 to avoid legal copyright risks. Use public domain classical or once-purchased royalty-free lofi/jazz for ambient music (SPEC_09).
notes: Aligns website scope with mobile app strategy.

quote_or_summary: The 30-second preview limit applies to promotional artist/band cards to avoid full playback copyright requirements. Ambient music has different requirements.
Standard REST upload is limited. For large files, use TUS protocol. Compressing/converting downloads to smaller bitrates mitigates this limit.
Content ID allows rights holders to monetize user-uploaded videos containing their audio on YouTube, but does not grant licensing for hosting files outside the platform.
notes: Distinguishes platform monetization from legal redistribution.

quote_or_summary: Commit history shows cozy-living-jazz.m4a and quiet-cafe-jazz.m4a were downloaded from YouTube compilations, posing a DMCA takedown risk if hosted on Vercel/Netlify.
Decoupling playlist metadata from page code and reading it from JSON or database enables updating music lists without rebuilding or redeploying code.
Archive.org Scraping and search APIs can be queried using standard Python libraries to fetch metadata and direct download links.
